question: As it is used in paragraph 10, the word "settled" most nearly means:
According to the passage, Odile Brask's first assignment asked students to:

options.A: copy a famous composition from a dozen small thumbnail sketches.
options.B: photograph their best pages so that they could share them with others.
options.C: draw something they could not draw well and leave it in the book.
options.D: keep a second, cheaper pad of paper that no one else would ever see.

question: According to the passage, customers rate waits in a single winding line as shorter mainly because in such a line:

options.A: no one who arrived later can be served ahead of them.
options.B: each customer can choose whichever counter appears to be free.
options.C: people move through faster on average than in several lines.
options.D: the waiting time is posted on a screen near the start of the line.

question: Both authors would most likely agree that:

options.A: shedding has little to do with how quickly a tree's trunk is growing wider.
options.B: trees that shed their bark tend to have cleaner trunks than trees that keep it.
options.C: the plants that live on bark seldom do a tree any real harm over time.
options.D: a tree sheds most heavily in the years when its trunk widens fastest.
